let captured: string | number = "before";
class Fields {
  readonly instance = captured;
  static field = captured;
}
captured = 1;
new Fields().instance.toUpperCase();
Fields.field.toUpperCase();

let fallback: string | number = "before";
function declared(value = fallback) { return value.toUpperCase(); }
const arrow = (value = fallback) => value.toUpperCase();
const object = { read(value = fallback) { return value.toUpperCase(); } };
fallback = 1;
declared();
arrow();
object.read();

function conditional(first: number | undefined, fallback = (first ??= 1), last = first) {
  return last;
}
const result: number = conditional(undefined);
